title: SC03-T1 — the undoing (SH01, SH02a, SH02b, SH03, SH04, SH05)
line: When did I start looking like this? Tired. Worn out. / Older than I am. No wonder he stopped looking at me.
motionPlan: Michelle sits on the stool at the vanity in her robe, looking at her reflection in the oval mirror → Michelle, hollow, says it to her reflection, touching the shadow under one eye with a fingertip → Michelle, hollow, says it to her reflection, touching the shadow under one eye with a fingertip → her hand lays a small framed photograph (the size of a paperback) face down on the vanity → in profile, Michelle pats thick beige foundation from an unlabelled bottle over her cheeks with her fingers, layer on layer → over her shoulder, the mirror shows her face caked and grey; she looks away from it
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
